claim: kine maintainer (brandond, 2021-11-20): 'Kine will never support dumping to an etcd compatible snapshot, as it doesn't use the same database format'; the supported route to etcd snapshots is migrating to embedded etcd with --cluster-init

k3s v1.32.5+k3s1: SQLite-to-etcd migration with --cluster-init crashed ('panic: non-positive interval for NewTicker' in the kine v0.13.15 sqllog compactor) and the restart came up as an empty cluster; maintainer: 'this was broken by k3s-io/kine#464'; fixed via k3s PR #12293
k3s had no end-to-end test of the SQLite-to-etcd migration until a maintainer requested one on 2025-06-16 after #12478; issue closed 2025-07-22

Single-server k3s SQLite corruption ('database disk image is malformed', compaction failing) is reported upstream; maintainer: 'There is nothing that can be done within K3s to prevent this', causes named as broken filesystem locking, unsafe termination or power loss; #2623 (v1.18.6) was auto-closed as stale with no fix, #9787 (v1.22.7/v1.24.4) closed with no confirmed fix, last activity 2026-03-30

Post-mortem (2024-12): a Raspberry Pi 4 k3s cluster's SQLite datastore failed integrity_check ('database disk image is malformed'), .recover and .dump failed, a raw-file backup was restored successfully; the DB later grew to 1.5 GB with compaction failing; author concludes logical backups are safer than raw SQLite file copies [status note: secondary source; the claim is stated as what that source reports]

kine maintainer concentration: of human-authored commits to k3s-io/kine since 2025-11-10, brandond authored 42 of 50 (mrueg 5, dereknola 2, mhmxs 1; dependabot's 41 excluded); all-time brandond 190 commits vs next human 64
SUSE lifecycle: each k3s minor is supported about 17-18 months from GA to EOL for 1.31-1.37 (1.37: GA 2026-09-14, EOL 2028-02-28); 13-14 months for 1.23-1.30
k3s 1.37 release post adds kine's new T4 (S3-compatible object storage) and Memory ('perfect for CI') drivers and tunes connection-pool defaults; it does not mention SQLite

k3s docs describe SQLite backup only as 'take a copy of /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db/' with no WAL or online-backup caveat, and position embedded SQLite for 'a simple, short-lived cluster in your CI/CD environment'
